sentences.text: This appeal by the claimant under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of the award dated 29.09.2018 passed by XXIII Member MACT, Indore in Claim Case No.345/2017 on account of in adequacy of compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.
2. The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability are not in dispute and the findings recorded by the Tribunal in this regard are also not in question.

As per the findings of the Tribunal,
in case of injured Yashwant, the Tribunal has awarded a total compensation of Rs.4,11,443/- along with interest from the date of filing of the claim petition till realisation.

3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case as the amount awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side.
The Tribunal has committed error in considering the income of the injured as Rs.5,000/-.

The Tribunal has committed error in awarding meagre amount under the head of pain and suffering, special diet, transportation, attendant, income during treatment and also treating permanent disability of 10%.
Hence, prays for just and proper amount of compensation in the case.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company argued in support of the impugned award and contended that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation amount in the case which does not call for any interference by this Court.

5. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, I find substance in the arguments advanced by the counsel for the appellant.

Considering the evidence that came on record,
in the considered opinion of this Court, the income of the claimant assessed by the Tribunal for calculating the compensation amount is on the lower side which deserves to be enhanced as under:
Permanent Disability Rs.2,01,828/- (Rs.6,950+10% x 12 x 11 x 20%)

Medical Bills Rs.3,13,843/-
Pain and suffering/transportation/ Rs.60,000/-

Accordingly, the appellant is entitled to an additional sum of Rs.1,64,228/- over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.
10. In the result, the appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensa- tion amount by a sum of Rs.1,64,228/-.
The enhanced amount shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.
11. In the result, the appeal is allowed in part and to the extent indicated herein above.
